I have no moral obligations to rocks, or to worms (though if it were demonstrated that dogs, fish, rocks and worms had a depth of subjective experience that I'm not currently aware of, my stance on this would instantly and automatically change). Fetuses in the first trimester don't appear to have the ability to experience anything, which is to say it is not like anything to be a fetus in the early stages of development. We should be far more concerned about the cows in our slaughterhouses than we are about early-stage fetuses.
